brief.title: Project auto-register: connect-phase timeout should mark failed
brief.description: Fix the project auto-register flow so that a URLError(TimeoutError) in the connect phase is recorded as failed. Today the registration still shows as pending. The ledger task has no body beyond its title, so the exact code path (likely the hook-minted project id auto-register from PR #90) must be found in the repo.

sources.body:
Title: Project auto-register: URLError(TimeoutError) connect-phase shows still pending; should be failed
Status: pending (state: open)
Body: (none; the ledger row has no body and no plan path)

tldr:
The SessionStart hook reports a connect-phase timeout (URLError wrapping TimeoutError) as "still pending". The daemon never accepted that connection, so no row will be created.
Change yadgar/core/cli/hook.py::_post_project_register so any URLError returns "failed". A bare TimeoutError (response wait after the daemon accepted the request) still returns "timeout".
The banner then prints the existing WARNING line naming project_register instead of "still pending".
Docstrings, docs/reference/hooks.md and CHANGELOG get updated. Core goes 5.198.0 -> 5.198.1 and backend 5.89.0 -> 5.89.1 (compat-window cascade).

repo_obligations.instruction: Bump core to 5.198.1 with `python3 scripts/bump_version.py --new 5.198.1`; let sync-version / sync-uv-lock hooks cascade the mirrors (server.json version, flake.nix, uv.lock, docker-compose.yml CORE_VERSION) and stage them.

Set version_compat.json core.max to 5.198.1. That file is a backend input, so also bump backend_version 5.89.0 -> 5.89.1 in server.json, set backend.max to 5.89.1, and update the mirrors (yadgar/__init__.py BACKEND_VERSION, flake.nix backend default, docker-compose.yml BACKEND_VERSION). Same pattern as commit 8993f6af.

Add a top entry under ## [Unreleased]: bold lead sentence (no **vX.Y.Z inline marker), core 5.198.0 -> 5.198.1, backend 5.89.0 -> 5.89.1 (version bump only), and the change: a connect-phase timeout on POST /hooks/project-register now prints the WARNING line instead of 'still pending' (ledger 1918).

repo_obligations.instruction: In docs/reference/hooks.md banner list (~lines 248-257) say 'still pending' applies only when the daemon accepted the request and the response did not arrive in 3 s; a connect timeout gets the WARNING line. Fix the _post_project_register docstring and _REGISTER_TIMEOUT_S comment in hook.py that say both timeout shapes are timeouts. README has no text on this banner; no README edit.

Move the URLError(TimeoutError) parametrize case from the timeout test to the failed test without deleting or loosening any assert line. If the hook still flags it, add one targeted .test-weakening-allowlist.json entry with reason 'spec change: ledger 1918'.
